group_outline_label.admin_behavior: Shows in the nested document outline; empty or absent uses the localized block type.
group_outline_label.catalog_behavior: Editor metadata only; public renderer intentionally ignores this attribute.

unsaved_changes.scope: Form fields and valid block editor changes in the current page instance.
unsaved_changes.signal: Browser beforeunload confirmation; no custom text and no autosave.
unsaved_changes.submit: Guard is bypassed only for a normal form submit when all block editor hosts validate. Invalid editor submission remains guarded.
unsaved_changes.persistence: The existing explicit Blog form save remains authoritative.

patterns_persistence.user_choice: Prepare design proposal; do not implement persistent storage in this increment.
patterns_persistence.scope_recommended: Private per-admin-user patterns, not global/shared by default.
patterns_persistence.authorization: Do not infer write permission from the Blog post modify ACL. Request a dedicated ACL decision or explicit mapping from the owner before endpoints/storage.
patterns_persistence.schema: Not included; obtain install-agent review and migration/schema approval before any persistence implementation.
patterns_persistence.storage_or_endpoint: None implemented. Built-in patterns remain local insertion patterns from F9-24.

catalog_context_preview.constraint: No public preview endpoint, share token, draft URL, or network request added.
catalog_context_preview.next_design: Review a same-origin, authenticated, CSRF-protected preview path that invokes the server allowlisted renderer on validated draft JSON without writing a post or exposing a public bearer URL. Confirm ACL, origin and expiration rules first.
